llms.body:
# Storyblok

> Storyblok is a headless content management system (CMS) designed to empower both developers and marketers by combining an API-first approach with a visual editor for seamless content creation and management. It offers scalable, flexible, and enterprise-grade solutions to build, manage, and deliver content across multiple channels efficiently. Trusted by global brands, Storyblok facilitates collaboration, integration, and innovation in modern web development and content workflows.

## Home

- [https://www.storyblok.com](https://www.storyblok.com): Introduction to Storyblok's capabilities as a leading headless CMS with visual editing. Highlights key performance metrics such as improvements in content operation speeds, the volume of pages created, and reductions in development time. Showcases prominent global brands trusting Storyblok.

## Platform

- [Product](https://www.storyblok.com/platform): Discover how Storyblok empowers teams to create, manage, and optimize content that converts.
- [Why Storyblok](https://www.storyblok.com/why-storyblok): Learn why developers and marketers choose Storyblok for its flexibility and scalability.
- [Ecosystem](https://www.storyblok.com/ecosystem): Explore the Storyblok ecosystem, including integrations, partners, and community resources.
- [Storyblok Labs](https://www.storyblok.com/lp/labs): Get early access to experimental features and contribute to the future of Storyblok.
- [App Directory](https://www.storyblok.com/app-store): Browse through all Storyblok apps to extend your content management capabilities.
- [Roadmap](https://www.storyblok.com/roadmap): Stay informed about upcoming features and improvements in Storyblok.

## Solutions (By Profile)

- [Enterprise](https://www.storyblok.com/enterprises): Scale your content experiences without a worry.
- [Developers](https://www.storyblok.com/lp/developers): Empowering developers to build with flexibility and speed.
- [Marketers](https://www.storyblok.com/marketers): Streamline your marketing workflows with Storyblok's intuitive interface.
- [AI Search](https://www.storyblok.com/lp/ai-search): Enhance your content's discoverability with AI-powered search features.
- [Why Content Is Critical](https://www.storyblok.com/lp/content-competitive-edge): Understand the importance of content in maintaining a competitive edge.

## Developers

- [Quick Start](https://www.storyblok.com/technologies): Begin your project with your preferred technology stack.
- [Documentation](https://www.storyblok.com/docs): Access comprehensive documentation to guide your development process.
- [Concepts](https://www.storyblok.com/docs/concepts): Familiarize yourself with the core concepts of Storyblok.
- [Developer Tutorials](https://www.storyblok.com/tutorials): Learn through practical tutorials crafted by experts.
- [APIs](https://www.storyblok.com/docs/api): Explore Storyblok's API documentation for seamless integration.
- [Changelog](https://www.storyblok.com/changelog): Keep up to date with the latest changes and updates in Storyblok.

## Partners

- [Find a Solution Partner](https://www.storyblok.com/partners/solution): Connect with certified partners to bring your projects to life.
- [Become a Partner](https://www.storyblok.com/partners): Join Storyblok's solution partner program and expand your business opportunities.
- [Partner Resources](https://www.storyblok.com/partners): Access resources to support your partnership with Storyblok.
- [Login to Partner Portal](https://app.storyblok.com/#!/?partner=1): Access the partner portal to manage your partnership details.

## Resources

- [Blog](https://www.storyblok.com/blog): Read the latest articles and insights from Storyblok.
- [Whitepapers](https://www.storyblok.com/lp/whitepapers): Download whitepapers and guides to deepen your knowledge.
- [Case Studies](https://www.storyblok.com/case-studies): Explore customer success stories and learn from their experiences.
- [Webinars & Events](https://www.storyblok.com/events): Join our webinars and events to stay connected and informed.
- [Content Editor Guides](https://www.storyblok.com/docs/manuals): Master content editing with our comprehensive guides.
- [FAQs](https://www.storyblok.com/docs): Find answers to frequently asked questions.
- [Service & Support](https://www.storyblok.com/trust-center/service-support): Learn more about Storyblok's support services.
- [AI Knowledge Hub](https://www.storyblok.com/lp/ai-knowledge-hub): Access curated resources on AI and its applications.

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://www.storyblok.com/pricing): Explore Storyblok's pricing plans to find the best fit for your needs.

The Enterprise CMS Built for AI + Humans

Storyblok orchestrates agent & human collaboration in a workspace
that content teams love and dev teams control.

Contact UsTry for Free

| #1 Headless CMS

Home home In review
https://storyblok.com/home

Scale Content Everywhere

Great content starts with an idea. Bring yours to life here. Change a headline or try a new color and see what happens.

Try it Free
Hero Component
Background

AI is only as good as the content it runs on

Storyblok gives your organization one trusted foundation for your content.

One version of the truth

At Storyblok, every piece of content lives in one place, follows a defined model, and has a clear owner.

Structured for search

Content built on a defined model means that search engines and AI tools can actually find and use your content.

Governed at every stage

Enterprise-grade roles, workflows, approvals, and audit trails so that you can ship globally with compliance your business requires to effectively implement AI.

The hidden cost of content debt

Every enterprise is carrying content it cannot account for. Old pages and assets nobody has owned for years. It carries a cost even when nobody is looking at it.

Content Debt:
A $4.63 Trillion Business Liability

These figures are based on Storyblok research conducted in collaboration with FT Longitude on the cost of unmanaged content.

Explore the report to learn how the estimates were developed, review the key findings, and see why content debt has become a growing business challenge.

Read the report

From build to live, faster than you'd believe

See what's possible when dev and marketing move as one.

  • 50%
    increase in content operations speed
  • 486,000+
    total pages created
  • 2 months
    to build 16 global sites
  • 50%
    reduction in development time

Your agents showed up ready to work.
Your content should too.

Our native MCP Server gives agents direct access to your structured content, and Strata makes every word of it searchable by meaning.

Agentic Experiences with our MCP Server

Agents are only as smart as the content they can read and action they know about.

Storyblok's native MCP Server connects any agent directly to your content - complete with full awareness of your structure, schemas, and brand voice. The result? Agents that don't just access your content. They get it.

Explore our MCP Server

Your content already has the answers. Strata makes them easier to find.

Native vector-powered semantic search that unlocks more from your content.

With your content vectorized and ready for intelligent processing, Strata unlocks new possibilities, from smarter website search and AI-powered assistants to personalized experiences and more intelligent workflows.

Explore Strata
